five_field_difference_audit.public_problem: When delegated participation ends or changes, the city lacks a reachable task for returning explanation, control, and stop authority to the person whose voice, image, work, feedback, or derived versions remain in AI systems.
affected_users: young people moving from delegated participation to independent action
people without the original account or device
whole_task: record a due-for-review trigger without AI declaring legal status
quiet-freeze new personalization, display, and derivative use
person chooses continue, limit, export, correct, withdraw, or dispute
synchronize downstream action and independent appeal
named_human_decision: Young-Person Support Steward: explains the inventory and records the person's choice without steering it
Identity and Authority Verifier: checks the trigger and authority conflict without asking AI to infer age or capacity
Content and Rights Reviewer: separates joint authorship, lawful retention, public display, and derived-use questions
Independent Appeal Reviewer: may hold or reverse a transfer, publication, deletion, or continued-use decision
five_field_difference_audit.failure_public_result: Keep new use frozen, isolate any potentially required retained record, keep ordinary learning and public service available, and publish only de-identified gap and repair types.
five_field_difference_audit.nearest_neighbor_difference: Nearby youth packages cover guardian consent and general withdrawal; dual-memory covers bounded retention; quiet-likeness covers incapacity or posthumous silence. None reviewed combines a transition-to-self trigger, pre-review freeze, human authority verification, the person's multi-option disposition, downstream reconciliation, and dispute hold as one complete public task.
five_field_difference_audit.falsification: If any current proposal covers the same affected users, complete lifecycle, carrier, named authority, and failure result, classify this candidate as convergent and do not rename or resubmit it.

entry_gates.requirement: A plain-language footprint inventory exists and names every known copy and derivative.
A named human has verified the trigger and the authority to act; AI has not inferred age or capacity.
New personalization, public display, and derived use are physically or logically frozen before review.
Joint creators, legal retention, safety, and contested authority have separate hold paths.
The person can choose continue, limit, export, correct, withdraw, or dispute through staffed and paper routes.
AI-off processing, downstream synchronization, and independent appeal all pass synthetic rehearsal.
